scripts.text:
[Geffen Guide]
Welcome to Geffen,
the City of Magic. If you
need any guidance around
the city, feel free to ask me
and I'll do my best to assist you. ^FFFFFFcobo^000000
scripts.translation:
[吉芬嚮導]
歡迎來到魔法之城——吉芬。
如果需要城內的路線指引，請隨時問我，我會盡力為您提供幫助。 ^FFFFFFcobo^000000

scripts.text: City Guide
scripts.translation: 城市導覽

scripts.text:
[Geffen Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
Would you like me
to mark locations
on your Mini-Map?
scripts.translation:
[吉芬嚮導]
請從以下選單中選擇一個地點。
您希望我在小地圖上標記這些地點嗎？

scripts.text:
[Geffen Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
scripts.translation:
[吉芬嚮導]
請從以下選單中選擇一個地點。

scripts.text:
[Geffen Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Geffen Guide]
The Magic Academy in
northwest Geffen handles
Job Changes to the Mage class.
scripts.translation:
[吉芬嚮導]
請從以下選單中選擇一個地點。
[吉芬嚮導]
吉芬西北方的魔法學院負責辦理魔法師的轉職手續。

scripts.text:
[Geffen Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Geffen Guide]
The Forge Shop is
located just southeast
from the center of Geffen.
scripts.translation:
[吉芬嚮導]
請從以下選單中選擇一個地點。
[吉芬嚮導]
鍛造店位於吉芬市中心的東南方。

scripts.text:
[Geffen Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Geffen Guide]
The Weapon Shop
can be found northwest
from the center of Geffen.
scripts.translation:
[吉芬嚮導]
請從以下選單中選擇一個地點。
[吉芬嚮導]
武器店位於吉芬市中心的西北方。

scripts.text:
[Geffen Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Geffen Guide]
You can find the
Tool Shop by heading
southwest from the
center of Geffen.
scripts.translation:
[吉芬嚮導]
請從以下選單中選擇一個地點。
[吉芬嚮導]
從吉芬市中心往西南走，就能找到道具店。

scripts.text:
[Geffen Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Geffen Guide]
The Pub can be
found northeast
from the Geffen Tower.
scripts.translation:
[吉芬嚮導]
請從以下選單中選擇一個地點。
[吉芬嚮導]
酒館位於吉芬塔的東北方。

scripts.text:
[Geffen Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Geffen Guide]
The Inn can be
found by traveling
northeast from the
center of Geffen.
scripts.translation:
[吉芬嚮導]
請從以下選單中選擇一個地點。
[吉芬嚮導]
從吉芬市中心往東北走，就能找到旅館。

scripts.text:
[Geffen Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Geffen Guide]
Geffen Tower is found
in the center of the city.
The Wizard Guild is at the
top, and there's even a dungeon
underneath it. There's many a
mystery surrounding that tower...
scripts.translation:
[吉芬嚮導]
請從以下選單中選擇一個地點。
[吉芬嚮導]
吉芬塔位於市中心。
塔頂是巫師公會，塔下甚至還有一座地下城。
這座塔藏著許多謎團...

scripts.text:
[Geffen Guide]
Please ask me to ''Remove
Marks from Mini-Map'' if you
no longer wish to have the
location marks displayed
on your Mini-Map.

如果不想讓小地圖繼續顯示地點標記，請選擇“移除小地圖示記”。

scripts.text:
[Geffen Guide]
Advances in sorcery and
technology have allowed
us to update our information
system, enabling up to mark
locations on your Mini-Map
for easier navigation.
scripts.translation:
[吉芬嚮導]
魔法與科技的進步讓我們得以更新資訊系統，現在可以在您的小地圖上標記地點，方便您辨認方向。

scripts.text:
[Geffen Guide]
Your Mini-Map is located
in the upper right corner
of the screen. If you can't
see it, press the Ctrl + Tab
keys or click the ''Map'' button in your Basic Info Window.
scripts.translation:
[吉芬嚮導]
小地圖位於螢幕右上角。
如果看不到，請按Ctrl + Tab，或點選基本資訊視窗中的“地圖”按鈕。

scripts.text:
[Geffen Guide]
On your Mini-Map,
click on the ''+'' and ''-''
symbols to zoom in and
our of your Mini-Map. We
hope you enjoy your travels
here in the city of Geffen.
scripts.translation:
[吉芬嚮導]
點選小地圖上的“+”和“-”，就能放大或縮小地圖。
祝您在吉芬遊歷愉快。

scripts.text:
[Geffen Guide]
Alright, adventurer.
I wish you safety on
your journeys through
the lands you may travel...
scripts.translation:
[吉芬嚮導]
好的，冒險者。
願您無論走到哪裡，都一路平安...
